items.name: blue keycard
items.desc: A blue plastic keycard. It fits a blue card reader.

items.name: red keycard
items.desc: A red plastic keycard with a notched corner so you can tell it by touch.

items.name: green keycard
items.desc: A green keycard with two raised dots on one side.

items.name: yellow keycard
items.desc: A yellow keycard with a rough, textured strip.

items.name: violet keycard
items.desc: A violet keycard with a round hole punched in it.

items.name: battery
items.desc: A heavy nine-volt battery. Powers the rescue radio.

items.name: juice box
items.desc: Apple juice. Drinking it eases exhaustion, so your breathing stays quiet.

items.name: granola bar
items.desc: A crunchy granola bar. Eases exhaustion and helps a little with health.

items.name: bandage
items.desc: A roll of bandage. Restores health.

items.name: noise-maker
items.desc: A wind-up alarm clock. Throw it and its ringing draws zombies away from you.

items.name: door wedge
items.desc: A rubber door wedge. Jam it under a door next to you so zombies cannot open it.

items.name: crowbar
items.desc: A heavy crowbar. Better than fists in a fight, and it can pry open jammed doors.

items.name: folding cane
items.desc: Your folding cane. It sweeps ahead as you walk and warns you of walls and obstacles. Press X to tap ahead.

items.name: monocular
items.desc: Your handheld monocular. Use it to read large-print signs, including exit signs across a room.

items.name: braille reader card
items.desc: A pocket braille reference card. With it, braille number labels are double-checked and read back as digits.

items.name: rescue radio
items.desc: A rescue radio. Each call uses battery power. The extraction team is on the other end.

items.name: tuning fork
items.desc: A steel tuning fork tagged 'Sonic lock reference'. It sounds the reference tone for a pitch lock.

items.name: antibody sample
items.desc: A cold metal case holding Antibody Sample A-23, made from your blood. This is the cure.
